failure.title: Clean mutation audit exposed nine genuine behavioral assertion gaps
failure.note: The first harness-clean 2,207-mutant report had zero runtime, compile, and no-coverage errors, but survivor review identified nine behavioral gaps that could not be classified as equivalent.
failure.diagnosis: Tests did not distinguish a volume-operation diagnostic, DomainError naming, fingerprint whitespace normalization, the second exercise-equivalence tuple and unknown-equivalence detail, readiness 4001 rejection, or the candidate-row FOR UPDATE lock.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
